_about: Every voice-over line in Aqua Energizer. make_voices.bat reads this file. Edit a line's text, then choose 'Redo one line'. Words in [brackets] are ElevenLabs audio tags (v3/v4 models): they set the delivery and are not spoken.

audition.narrator: [softly] Deep in the sea, the reef glows with magic pearls. [gently] But one little diver turns on a light.
audition.diver: [excited] Woohoo! The light's back! [giggles] Easy as bubbles!
audition.pip: [excited] I'm Pip! The storm blew out my glow, but look, I'm sparkling again!
audition.shelly: [warmly, slowly] Hop on, little one. I'll take you as far as my old flippers go.
audition.murk: [softly] It's warm... I'd forgotten what light feels like.
audition.lumen: [cheerful] Twenty gates! The whole Deep felt that. I'll light your way.
audition.friend: [cheerful] Found 'em in the sand after the storm! We're taking 'em back to the gates.

lines.text: [softly] Deep in the sea, the reef glows with magic pearls.
lines.when: Intro film: the reef at night

lines.text: [a little worried] One night, a huge storm hits the reef…
…and sweeps all the pearls away. [whispers] The reef goes dark.
lines.when: Intro film: the lights blow away

lines.text: [gently] But one little diver turns on a light.
lines.when: Intro film: the helmet lamp clicks on

lines.text: Swim into the sand to dig a tunnel.
The tunnel reaches the gate. Now get behind the red pearl…
lines.when: Intro film: diver above the gate

lines.text: [excited] …and push it to the gate!
[amazed] The gate wakes up, and the light comes back!
Twenty-nine gates are still dark. [warmly] Can you wake them all?
This is you. Swim, dig and push your way to the gate.
This red pearl is full of light. The gate needs it.
Push the pearl in to wake the gate, then swim in yourself.
Air starts on your first move, so look around first. Finish before it runs out!
Swipe to swim. Swim into sand to dig through it.
Use the arrow keys to swim. Swim into sand to dig through it.
Take the sand away under a stone, and it falls.
[gently] Never stand right under a stone!
Falling stones and pearls roll off round things, and they roll left first.
[a little worried] It patrols the water, and charges the moment it sees you.
[playfully] Drop a stone on it to stop it for good.
It drifts up and down its shaft. Cross when it is far away.
It scuttles back and forth. Stay out of its path!
[brightly] Swim into it for forty-five more seconds of air.
[warmly] Deeper now. Welcome to the Coral Caves. [softly] Plan before you dig.
[hushed] This is The Deep. Only the bravest divers come this far.
[cheerfully] Today's dive is the same for every diver. Ready? Go!
[amazed] Every gate is awake. The whole reef is glowing again!
[warmly] Thank you, little diver. The Glow Reef shines because of you.
[excited] Woohoo! The light's back!
Gate's awake. Onward!
[giggles] Easy as bubbles!
[sighs] Oof… let's try that again.
[determined] Hold on, I've got this!
[happy] Got one!
One more!
[giggles] In you go!
[excited] It's open!
Yes! Let's go!
[gasps] Ooh, treasure!
[giggles] Bonk!
[excited] Double!
[relieved] Phew!
That was close!
[nervous] I need air!
Whoops!
[playfully] Wait, wait… one more time!
[gently] The first gate wakes, and its light rushes into an old pipe.
[gently] The pipe carries you out onto the sand, toward the next glass tank.
[excited] Psst! Down here! You woke a gate? Nobody’s done that since the storm!
[curious] I just followed the light. Who are you?
[excited] I’m Pip! The storm blew out my glow, and every light in the reef.
[excited] But when your gate woke, I sparkled. Look, just a little!
[excited] Old stories say thirty gates carry light down to the Great Lantern.
[curious] Then let’s wake all thirty. Lead the way, Pip!
[gently] Old Shelly the turtle has swum these waters for two hundred years.
[warmly, slowly] The Lantern, little one? It stands in the Deep. Its Heart Pearl lights the whole reef.
[warmly, slowly] The storm scattered the Lantern’s pearls. Without them, the gates fall asleep.
[warmly, slowly] Hop on. I’ll take you as far as my old flippers go.
[gently] A parade of crabs marches past, each one carrying a pearl.
[cheerful] Found ’em in the sand after the storm! We’re taking ’em back to the gates.
[cheerful] But most of the pearls were dragged away… by a shadow. Deep and wide, it was.
[excited] A shadow? I don’t like the sound of that.
[gently] The jellies remember the gates. They hum whenever one wakes.
[excited] Five gates! Listen, the jellies are humming!
[gently] They make a bouncy stair to lift you to the next tank.
[curious] Boing… boing… whoa! Thank you, jellies!
[gently] Inside an old shipwreck sits a chest with a seashell clasp.
[gently] In it: a map of all thirty gates, and a page from the Reef Keeper’s journal.
[gently] “If the Lantern ever fades, wake the gates one by one. The light will find its way home.”
lines.when: Chapter 6 · The Old Wreck (The Reef Keeper)

lines.text: [excited] The Reef Keeper! I thought that was just a bedtime story!
[gently] Seven gates glow on the Keeper’s map now.
[gently] A warm current, flowing again for the first time since the storm, scoops you up.
[curious] Wheeeee!
[excited] The reef is helping us! It wants its light back.
[gently] Since the storm, the fish have swum in lost little circles.
[gently] As your gate wakes, they remember the way, and form a silver arrow.
[excited] They’re pointing to the edge of the Shallows.
[excited] Past it are the Coral Caves… I’ve never been that far.
[gently] At the top of the great dune, you spot dark streaks in the sand.
[excited] Ink… Something big came this way, dragging pearls behind it.
[gently] There’s only one way to follow it. Down!
[curious] Hold on, Pip!
[gently] The ink trail ends at a cliff. Far below, the Coral Caves glow violet.
lines.when: Chapter 10 · The Edge of the Shallows (narrator)

lines.text: [excited] It’s so dark down there… What if the shadow is waiting?
lines.when: Chapter 10 · The Edge of the Shallows (Pip)

lines.text: [curious] Then we’ll bring our own light. Together?
lines.when: Chapter 10 · The Edge of the Shallows (You)

lines.text: [excited] …Together!
lines.when: Chapter 10 · The Edge of the Shallows (Pip)

lines.text: [gently] The Coral Caves have been dark since the storm.
[gently] Your lamp wakes the crystals one by one, and they glow back like old friends.
[excited] Eleven gates! Look, I’m brighter than the crystals!
[excited] And there, more ink… The shadow went deeper.
[gently] Giant clams open, one after another…
[gently] …and sing an old song the Reef Keeper taught them, long ago.
[gently] “Share your light, and the light comes home…”
lines.when: Chapter 12 · The Clam Choir (The Clam Choir)

lines.text: [excited] Those are the words from the journal!
[gently] Tiny glimmer jellies gather round you, curious.
[gently] They have never met a diver. Only the Keeper, long, long ago.
[excited] They say the Keeper had a lamp just like yours.
[curious] Just like mine…?
[gently] The Great Canyon splits the caves in two.
[gently] A gentle manta named Mira offers you a ride across.
[cheerful] Hold on tight, little one. The current here is strong!
lines.when: Chapter 14 · The Manta Glide (Mira the manta)

lines.text: [excited] Woohoo! Fourteen gates, and flying!
[gently] Deep in the caves, something huge blinks in the dark.
[gently] Two great eyes, and a long arm wrapped around a bundle of pearls…
[excited] Th-that’s the shadow!
[gently] Before you can say hello, it slips away into the black.
[gently] The old Coral Arch still remembers the light.
[gently] Its lamps wake as you swim through, and words glow in the stone:
[gently] “The light remembers those who share it.”
lines.when: Chapter 16 · The Coral Arch (The Coral Arch)

lines.text: [excited] Share it… even with the shadow?
[gently] Pearls the shadow dropped float up from the sand like lanterns.
[excited] It dropped them on purpose… It’s leaving us a trail!
[gently] Maybe the shadow wants to be found.
[curious] Then let’s find it.
[gently] Pip’s cousins have swum all the way from the Shallows.
[cheerful] Pip! You’re glowing! Race you to the next gate!
[excited] Eighteen gates, and the fastest seahorse in the caves!
[softly] Thank you for giving my glow back.
[gently] From the last cliff of the caves, you see it for the first time…
[gently] …the Great Lantern, standing dark at the bottom of the Deep.
[excited] Nineteen of its lights are on. Because of you!
[excited] But its Heart is still missing. The shadow must have it.
[gently] Into the Deep, where the sun has never reached.
[gently] A little light bobs toward you. It’s Lumen, the anglerfish.
[cheerful] Twenty gates! The whole Deep felt that. I’ll light your way.
[cheerful] The big one you’re following? His name is Murk. He isn’t mean… just scared.
[gently] High above, a whale sings for the first time since the storm.
[cheerful] That’s Old Bellow. He only sings when the Lantern is waking.
[excited] Twenty-one gates. More than halfway!
[gently] The song rolls through the Deep, and the dark feels a little smaller.
[gently] An old sea city sleeps in the dark. Its columns glow as you pass.
[gently] On the last wall, a mural: the Reef Keeper, and a little purple octopus.
[cheerful] Murk was the Keeper’s best friend.
[excited] Then why did he take all the pearls?
[warmly, slowly] There you are! I had to see the Lantern with my own old eyes.
[warmly, slowly] I remember the storm. A big octopus grabbed every pearl he could, to save them from the waves.
[excited] He wasn’t stealing them. He was protecting them!
[warmly, slowly] Hold on tight. The Deep is big, and we’re nearly there.
[gently] In a den full of pearls hides a giant octopus.
[softly, sadly] Go away… I got lost in the storm. It’s so dark, I can’t find the Lantern.
[softly, sadly] I kept the pearls safe. But I’m too scared to go back.
[excited] We’re not here to take them. We’re here to help.
[gently] You give Murk one glowing pearl from the gates.
[warmly] It’s warm… I’d forgotten what light feels like.
[warmly] The Keeper always said: share your light, and the light comes home.
[gently] For the first time in a very long time, Murk smiles.
[warmly] Climb on, little diver. I know the way now.
[gently] Murk carries you over the deepest trench in the sea.
[warmly] The Keeper left something for whoever came back. I’ll show you.
[excited] Twenty-six gates! I can feel the Lantern humming!
[cheerful] Wave your arms, little Keeper! The Deep is listening.
[gently] Every wave sets the plankton glowing, brighter and brighter.
[excited] Did Lumen just call you… Keeper?
[cheerful] Who else could light up a whole sea?
[gently] At last, the foot of the Great Lantern. Twenty-eight lights glow on its tower.
[gently] On its door, the Keeper left one last note:
[gently] “Murk, keep the Heart safe, until someone kind comes back.”
lines.when: Chapter 28 · The Lantern Tower (The Reef Keeper)

lines.text: [warmly] That someone… is you.
[gently] Murk brings out the Heart Pearl he has guarded since the storm.
[warmly] I kept it safe for you. Light it with the last gate.
[excited] Twenty-nine gates… One more, and the whole reef wakes up!
[curious] Let’s bring the light home.
